title: Globulation 2 map report, schema version 2
description: Field meanings and formulas: REPORT.md in this directory.

name.description: Stored map name; null for an unsaved generated snapshot.

player_slots.description: Actual colony count, not configured controller count.

controller_count.description: GameHeader controller slots; often zero in a newly generated map.

tick.description: Current simulation tick; no ticks are run by analysis.

game_seed.description: Stored game seed, not proof of the original map-generation seed.

type.description: 0 none, 1 dropping, 2 lost, 3 network, 4 local, 5 + AI implementation ID.

build_sites_4x4.description: Count of overlapping valid 4x4 top-left anchors; not simultaneous building capacity.

items.description: Euclidean distance in tiles between stored starts, shortest route across wrapping; null for unset starts.

tiles.description: Number of tiles in this category.

percent.description: 100 * tiles / denominator; null for zero denominator. See REPORT.md for each denominator.

min.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

max.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

mean.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

stddev.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

median.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

p10.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

p90.description: Population statistic; null when count is zero.

components.description: Connected components of the supplied tile mask on the torus.

largest_component_percent_of_passable.description: Percent of the mask in its largest component; null for an empty mask.

mean_fertility.description: Mean gated fertility in catchment; zero for empty catchment.

nearest_rival_distance.description: Nearest reachable rival in walking steps.

reachable_tiles.description: Walkable tiles reachable from starting ground units.

catchment_grass_tiles.description: Pure-grass tiles within the walking catchment.

catchment_buildable_tiles.description: Single tiles passing isFreeForBuilding within the catchment.

catchment_fertile_grass_tiles.description: Pure-grass catchment tiles with positive gated fertility.

catchment_growth_enabled_grass_tiles.description: Pure-grass catchment tiles with canResourcesGrow true.

exclusive_nearest_tiles.description: Walkable tiles uniquely closest to this colony.

tied_nearest_tiles.description: Walkable tiles tied for closest to this colony.

exclusive_catchment_tiles.description: Exclusive-nearest tiles also inside this colony catchment.

tied_catchment_tiles.description: Tied-nearest tiles also inside this colony catchment.

reachable_rivals.description: Other colonies reachable by walking from this colony.

farthest_rival_distance.description: Longest walking distance to a reachable rival; null if none.

total.description: Weighted mean, forced to zero if wheat or wood is unreachable.

worst.description: See REPORT.md for formula; null if unmeasured.

best.description: See REPORT.md for formula; null if unmeasured.

fairness.description: See REPORT.md for formula; null if unmeasured.

score.description: See REPORT.md for formula; null if unmeasured.

percent_of_resource_tiles.description: Percent of all occupied resource tiles, including unknown types in the denominator.

stored_amount.description: Sum of stored amount bytes, not lifetime supply.

nearest_gather_cost.description: Cost to the nearest neighbor of a positive-amount deposit, plus one.

reachable_deposit_tiles.description: Deposit counts or stored amounts; zero if none accessible.

reachable_stored_amount.description: Deposit counts or stored amounts; zero if none accessible.

catchment_deposit_tiles.description: Deposit counts or stored amounts; zero if none accessible.

catchment_stored_amount.description: Deposit counts or stored amounts; zero if none accessible.

source_tiles.description: Current ground-unit tiles used as sources.

open.description: Cost per entered tile; null means blocked.

water.description: Cost per entered tile; null means blocked.

clearable_resource.description: Cost per entered tile; null means blocked.

eternal_resource.description: Cost per entered tile; null means blocked.

building.description: Cost per entered tile; null means blocked.

items.description: Row = source colony; column = target colony. Null if unreachable; diagonal zero.

nearest_rival_spread.description: Largest minus smallest nearest-rival cost; null if any colony has no reachable rival.

unreachable_directed_pairs.description: Missing off-diagonal routes, counting each direction.

tied_tiles.description: Tiles shared by at least two equal-cost nearest colonies.

additionalProperties.description: Resolved CLI control value, with width/height in tiles.

items.description: GenerationRequest resourceAmounts array; indexed by resource ID.

nearest_gather_distance.description: Nearest neighboring walking tile plus one gathering step.

catchment_deposit_tiles.description: Accessible deposit tiles approached within catchment steps, including zero-amount deposits.

catchment_stored_amount.description: Stored amount of those accessible catchment deposits.

exclusive_catchment_deposit_tiles.description: Deposits approached strictly sooner than every rival and within catchment.

exclusive_catchment_stored_amount.description: Stored amount in exclusive catchment deposits.

tied_catchment_deposit_tiles.description: Deposits tied for best approach with a rival and within catchment.

tied_catchment_stored_amount.description: Stored amount in tied catchment deposits.

stored_amount.description: Current stored amount in accessible deposits.

exclusive_deposit_tiles.description: Deposits approached strictly before all rivals.

walking_steps.description: Inclusive fixed walking radius in steps.

fertile_grass_tiles.description: Pure grass with positive gated fertility in range.

exclusive_nearest_tiles.description: Range tiles uniquely nearest to this colony.

tied_nearest_tiles.description: Range tiles tied for nearest colony.
